page_title: REN 1-1 HAV | Rennes v Le Havre 18/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+9' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+9' The cross fools the defence and leaves Ludovic Blas (Rennes) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the left post.

90+7' What a wonderful moment! Valentin Rongier (Rennes) receives a perfect pass in the middle of the pitch, lines up the ball and unloads a powerful strike towards the bottom left corner. His effort fails to surprise Lionel Mpasi-Nzau, who makes a nice save.
90+6' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
90+6' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) serves up a nice cross, but Lionel Mpasi-Nzau punches the ball away. Corner kick. Rennes will have an opportunity.

90+4' A nice cross arrived in the box from the corner kick and found the head of Lilian Brassier (Rennes). He steered the ball towards the bottom right corner, but one of the defenders is there to cover the goalkeeper and keep it out.
90+4' The referee awards a corner and Ludovic Blas (Rennes) goes over to take it.
90+2' Breel Embolo (Rennes) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
90+2' The referee signals a substitution. Seko Fofana (Rennes) is brought on as a substitute for Przemyslaw Frankowski.
90+1' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Valentin Rongier (Rennes), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.
90+1' Rennes are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
90' Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) has tested the patience of referee Stephanie Frappart and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
88' Mohamed Meite (Rennes) has a goal ruled out for offside!
86' 1 - 1 Ludovic Blas produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Breel Embolo (Rennes) rises high to head the ball into the bottom left corner and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:1.
85' The resulting corner from Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is cleared.
85' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
83' Le Havre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

83' Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
80' Habib Beye decides to make a substitution. Mousa Tamari will be replaced by Elias Legendre (Rennes).

80' Big chance! A simple pass from Lilian Brassier left Mohamed Meite (Rennes) with just the keeper to beat inside the box, but his shot went agonisingly just past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
79' A substitution has been made. Felix Mambimbi is replaced by Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre).
79' Didier Digard has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) replacing Kenny Quetant.
79' Substitution. Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Timothee Pembele walks off.
76' The resulting set piece from Rennes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

76' A pass travels right across the box to Mohamed Meite (Rennes) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom right corner, but Lionel Mpasi-Nzau denies him with a decent save. The ball is out of play. Rennes will have a chance to score from a corner.
76' The referee shows the yellow card to Lionel Mpasi-Nzau (Le Havre).
75' Mohamed Meite (Rennes) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but it goes well wide of the left post.
75' The ball goes out for a corner. Rennes can continue in their attacking effort.
75' Valentin Rongier (Rennes) takes the resulting corner which is well defended. The ball is out of play. Rennes win a corner kick.
73' Here is a change. Esteban Lepaul is going off and Habib Beye gives the last tactical orders to Mohamed Meite (Rennes).
73' Here comes a substitution. Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is brought on as a substitute for Quentin Merlin.
72' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kenny Quetant (Le Havre) was quite harsh and Stephanie Frappart didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

69' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Rassoul Ndiaye lines up a shot and his effort takes a deflection off Felix Mambimbi (Le Havre) that wrong foots Brice Samba and sends it into the back of the net. It's 0:1.
68' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
67' Lilian Brassier (Rennes) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Rennes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
66' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Mousa Tamari (Rennes) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
62' The resulting corner from Valentin Rongier (Rennes) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
61' Celebrations are cut short for Rennes as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
61' The Rennes players halt their celebrations as referee Stephanie Frappart makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
59' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom left corner. Magnificent finish!
59' The corner from Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) is intercepted by Brice Samba.
56' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
52' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Lionel Mpasi-Nzau is equal to it and makes an easy save.
51' Valentin Rongier (Rennes) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
50' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
50' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play. Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
49' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Stephanie Frappart due to a handball, much to the disappointment of the Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) and his team.
48' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) takes the resultant free kick from distance and swings it into the box, but the goalkeeper climbs high to collect the ball.
45+4' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but his low effort is straight at Lionel Mpasi-Nzau.
45+4' Felix Mambimbi (Le Havre) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Rennes earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Mousa Tamari (Rennes).
44' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
42' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) is substituted due to injury. Didier Digard gives a chance to Timothee Pembele.
41' Lionel Mpasi-Nzau (Le Havre) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
40' Le Havre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
39' Brice Samba stretches to his right and makes a brilliant save! Ally Samatta (Le Havre) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the bottom left corner.
34' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
33' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.

32' Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Brice Samba shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
31' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
31' Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Le Havre get a corner.
30' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
28' Lilian Brassier (Rennes) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

26' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
25' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) takes the corner which is cleared.
24' Didier Digard is forced to make a change. Issa Soumare (Le Havre) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Ally Samatta.
19' The corner from Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) is hurriedly cleared.
18' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Lionel Mpasi-Nzau makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
14' The game is interrupted as Breel Embolo (Rennes) is flagged offside.
13' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
12' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.
8' Rennes are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
5' Valentin Rongier (Rennes) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
3' Rennes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
2' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman makes the right call and Rennes will have a corner.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Le Havre will have the kick-off.
Stephanie Frappart is introduced as the referee for today's match.
